verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, such as a full account export, a CSV or JSON download, or an account-closure data takeout. The List Transfers API and the fiat withdrawal and redeem flows only move funds or let a developer page through records. They are building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented capability to export all data in open formats and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
